findings.criterion: The layout includes a header, an option creation form, and an options list container.
findings.evidence: index.html contains <header class="app-header">, <form id="add-option-form">, and <div id="options-grid"> which serve as the header, option creation form, and options list container respectively.

findings.criterion: Users can add new named options using a text input and a submit button.
findings.evidence: index.html contains an input element with id="option-input" and a submit button with id="add-option-btn". app.js handles the submit event to add options.

findings.criterion: Added options are rendered as distinct cards or rows in the UI.
findings.evidence: app.js dynamically creates a div with class 'option-card' for each option and appends it to the options grid.

findings.criterion: The layout is fully responsive and adapts gracefully to mobile and desktop viewports.
findings.evidence: styles.css uses CSS Grid with media queries (@media (min-width: 640px) and @media (min-width: 1024px)) to adjust the grid columns from 1 to 2 and 3 columns respectively.

findings.criterion: No console errors occur when adding options.
findings.evidence: The deterministic evidence checks show console_clean is true, and the browser journey completed successfully.
